decision_rule.statement: Decided only by the cited QSL-20260930 rule, evaluated once: at 120 or more expiry-resolved cohorts per family, fully-crossed net mean above 0 with one-sided sign-flip p below 0.05 (10,000 draws), name-clustered bootstrap 95% CI low above 0, no single dropped name flipping the sign, both expiry halves agreeing in sign. minimum_sessions 67 is the measured projection of recorded sessions the binding family needs (QSL section 6), not a threshold of its own. The lane places no orders, so it has no lifecycles.

hypothesis: The sealed QSL-20260930 quote-bearing shadow ledger continues unchanged under its own pre-registration, owner and timers. This entry only cites it so the pilot roster names all three programs; it re-registers nothing and grants the lane no new requests, compute or storage (every pilot budget below is zero, so no pilot job can run under this program id).
